listing_id.note: Foreign key into data/annotation_ready/listings.csv. Pre-filled -- never edit this column.

annotator_id.note: Short handle identifying the human annotator, e.g. 'annotator_A'. Fill in once per template file.

label.note: See annotation/label_definitions.md for the exact criteria for each value.

confidence.note: 1 = mostly guessing, 5 = very confident given the available evidence. Precise per-value anchors, tied to the weak/strong/critical signal taxonomy: annotation/guidelines/LABEL_SCHEMA.json's confidence_scale, and annotation/guidelines/DECISION_RULES.md's confidence table.

evidence_reason.note: Must cite specific observable evidence (a field value, an image, a seller-behaviour fact) -- not a vibe.

reused_image_indicator.note: Pre-filled from the independent near-duplicate audit where known (see dataset_validation_report.md); annotators may override if they disagree after visually checking the images.
